q: In a parallel combination of capacitors, all the capacitors have the same _____.
e: All capacitors in parallel have the same potential difference.

q: In a parallel combination, the total charge Q is the _____ of the individual charges.
e: The total charge is the sum of individual charges.

q: The equivalent capacitance C of capacitors in parallel is C = _____.
e: The equivalent capacitance is $C = C_1 + C_2 + C_3$.

q: The equivalent capacitance of capacitors connected in parallel is the _____ of the capacitances of the individual capacitors.
e: It is the sum of the individual capacitances.

q: The equivalent capacitance of the parallel combination of n identical capacitors, each of capacitance $C_1$, is C = _____.
e: For n identical capacitors in parallel, $C = nC_1$.

q: In a series combination of capacitors, each capacitor has the same _____.
e: Each capacitor in series has the same charge.

q: In a series combination, the capacitors have different _____.
e: Capacitors in series have different potential differences.

q: The total potential difference V of a series capacitor combination is the _____ of individual potential differences.
e: The total potential difference is the sum of individual potential differences.

q: For capacitors in series, the reciprocal of the equivalent capacitance is the sum of the _____ of their individual capacitances.
e: It is the sum of the reciprocals of individual capacitances.

q: The equivalent capacitance C of the series combination of n identical capacitors, each of capacitance $C_1$, is C = _____.
e: For n identical capacitors in series, $C = C_1/n$.

q: In a parallel circuit diagram, the plates of the capacitors connected together at the point A have _____ charges.
e: The plates connected together at point A have positive charges.

q: In a series circuit diagram, the negatively charged plate of one capacitor is connected to the _____ charged plate of the other.
e: The negatively charged plate is connected to the positively charged plate.

q: There are two types of combination namely; (i) parallel and (ii) _____.
e: The two types of combinations are parallel and series.
